newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to sink.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to sink.

text.p: Millfeed prices continued to trend lower Friday as dealers throughout the central United States reported increasing supplies met by sagging demand.
Flour mills were operating six and seven days a week keeping dealers well supplied with material.
The availability of new-crop corn in southern regions, lush pastures in Texas and declining usage by the catfish industry in the southeast have curbed demand, dealers said.
Southern California prices eased slightly, but dealers there said demand from the dairy industry remains strong, largely offsetting increased production from flour mills.
"Everything is conducive to low prices for millfeeds," said a Missouri dealer.
